text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After our outing.
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi invited me to tag along to meet her friends,
and when we arrived at the meeting spot—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, Tsuru-chan.
Here comes today's guest of honor~.
choice_data_list: I heard you're all going out to have fun together?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm heading to the pool facility now.
Hehe... I've been waiting for this day.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
We've made promises so many times before, but...
every time, I ended up getting sick.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
But this time, we can all go hang out together!
Ehehe, I'm gonna have so much fun~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a pool with a sandy shore like a beach.
How nice, looks like we can enjoy it in style.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wah, there's a seashell in the sand!
All right, I'm gonna find the biggest one!

text_block_list.name: Male Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, a direct hit on the shark target!
My, what remarkable shooting skills you have, customer~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, somehow landed a big catch~♪
Guess lucky shots really do happen.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! That's amazing, Sei-chan!
But I won't lose either... Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, she enjoyed the attractions with her friends without taking a single break.
...However—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Phew... *wheeze*...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh...
Looks like she's about out of fuel.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You're right, you don't look too well either...
Why don't you lie down for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...N-No, I'm totally fine!
More importantly, what should we play next...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm finally... getting to play with both of you!
This isn't nearly enough... *cough*, *wheeze*!
choice_data_list: (Come to think of it, the other day too—)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...I-I'm fine...!
I'll see this through... to the end...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even during Yabusame, she gave it so much of her all that she collapsed.
...At this rate, history is going to repeat itself.
choice_data_list: Let's take a break from playing! Let's rest a bit over there.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... san...?
...Something like this... is no big deal at all...!
choice_data_list: If you collapse, you won't be able to play with the two of us anymore, you know?
If you collapse, you won't be able to play with the two of us anymore, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
! ...Uuu...
I, understand...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Fuhe~... After sleeping for a bit, I feel a lot better...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Geez, I get that you're excited,
but you're pushing yourself way too hard.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I feel bad about it too, you know.
But I've always been like this since way back.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I thought this might be my only chance...
So before I knew it, I was giving it everything I had.

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yay, a field trip~!
Tag, tree climbing, carrot rock-paper-scissors...
We're gonna play so much~!

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Th-That much...?
Tsuyoshi, please don't push yourself too hard, okay...?

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
No, I want to play with all my might!
I mean, I've had to rest this whole time.

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
There are so many things I wanted to do!
I'm gonna do every single one of them with all my might～!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Give everything your all!
Whenever there's an opportunity, go all out so you have no regrets!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Rather than worrying, joining in with her is what makes Tsuru-chan happiest~.
choice_data_list: I see. So you're "keeping me company"... huh.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Whoa, is it this late already?!
Time just flew by.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Still, I got to play to my heart's content with the two of them!
...I want to come back again.
choice_data_list: How about we bring even more people next time?
Maybe going to the beach would be nice next time.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's a wonderful idea!
Spe-chan, Grass-chan, and El-chan...
All of us at the pool!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's nice. In that case,
I should start thinking about the schedule.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Coordinating our schedules might be tough... but that's just how important of an opportunity this is.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna play with everything I've got,
so I won't have any regrets!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, true!
Playing beach volleyball together sounds like so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm, I can totally picture it...
Tsuru-chan going so all-out
she faceplants right into the sand.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I'll be super careful
not to collapse...
